RESOURCEDICE.DepletedWarning: {label} is depleted and cannot be rolled.
RESOURCEDICE.Settings.DecrementOn.Name: Decrement die on
RESOURCEDICE.Settings.DecrementOn.Hint: When a resource die is rolled, a result at or below this number steps the die down one size (1d8 → 1d6 → … → depleted). Default is 2. Set to 0 to never step down automatically.
